interpretation: A fresh process restores the serialized state and authored rules. Readiness guards preserve the previous resolved/consumed revision at the budget cut and permit correct recovery after restart. The unguarded reverse-order control persists a false commit; restart preserves that semantically wrong but internally restored state.
limits: Clean process exit and one fsync'ed JSON checkpoint; no kill during native execution or power-loss test.
One proposal family, one revision mutation, two rule orders, and two graph sizes.
Readiness guards are authored policies, not automatic engine contracts.
